label: Tool Storm
description: The five tools as window cards multiplying over the person: five that read as a hundred. mode 'fly': the windows arrive one by one from the sides and stack loosely (the first beat, readable). mode 'ring': they circle the frame, the same five coming round again, near cards big and bright, far ones small and dim (the second beat). mode 'storm': a blizzard of cards crossing the frame on their own lines with a spin, too fast to read, with white flashes (the third beat). Lightweight cards (the tool's colour, mark and the shape of its surface; no cursors, no figures) -- or style 'logo': each piece is a white app tile holding the tool's real logo (`logos`: image srcs), no window and no name, recognised at a glance. Sized to its box; every position is a function of the card's index so the frames are the same on every seek. Meant to ride over a live-action clip of the person. COLLAPSE (relay): collapse_at folds every piece into one point (collapse_to [x, y], default the centre) over collapse_duration and leaves a glowing dot published as the anchor `core` -- the next piece is born from it with enter {effect: "morph", from: "<this id>.core"}.

style.label: cards (default: window cards) | logo (a white app tile with the tool's logo -- needs logos)

logos.label: style logo: the logos, image srcs (or {src}), in the order they arrive; fly defaults count to their number

tools.label: Tools
tools.description: The tools, cycled in order (default all five)

count.label: Cards
count.description: How many windows (default 5 fly, 15 ring, 40 storm; max 80)

turn.label: Ring turns
turn.description: ring: full turns across the beat (default 0.9 x speed)

collapse_at.label: When every piece zings into one point and the storm folds away (s); omit to keep it

collapse_to.label: Where it collapses, [x, y] fractions of the box (default [0.5, 0.5])

core_size.label: The dot left behind, a fraction of the box's shorter side (default 0.05)

core_color.label: The dot's colour (default the brand primary)
